name: AWS
description: Your AWS accounts in every prifly session: any AWS API action through the access key filed in Vault → Connections. Reads answer at once; every write shows a confirm card and runs only on your click. Calls that reveal a secret, and Cost Explorer, are refused; a daily cost reading stands in for the latter. aws_create_access_key_to_vault makes a new IAM access key and files it straight into the Vault after one confirm card, so a session can use it with vault_run without ever seeing it. prifly signs every call; the extension never sees a secret.

connections.why: Calls the AWS API for your sessions: reads at once, and writes only after you confirm each one on a card. What the key may do is its IAM policy.
